 사진 확대 Photo: Yoo Yong-seok, reporter Actor Joo Jong-hyuk talked about the appeal of one-act dramas.
 A press conference for KBS Drama Special 2026 ‘Sound:Track’ was held at a location in Yongsan District, Seoul, on the morning of the 18th.
 KBS Drama Special 2026 ‘Sound:Track’ is a series of one-act dramas that takes ‘that song’—the one everyone has encountered at least once in their life—as its starting point and explores the memories and emotions contained in music through a total of eight stories. It carries on the tradition of KBS one-act dramas, which began with ‘Drama Game’ in 1984 and has continued for 42 years.
 Joo Jong-hyuk, who plays Jinu in ‘When My Loneliness Calls You,’ said, “It’s a song I really like, so I wondered how they would make it. Then I received a script I never expected, which felt fresh.” He added, “I think I encountered something special in the idea that when people part, they don’t feel only sadness, but a wide range of emotions.”
 Asked about appearing in a one-act drama again after doing so in 2022, he said, “One reason I like one-act dramas is that you have to create a finished work in a short time, and there’s an intensity to that. All the staff charge toward one goal without hesitation. It brought back the feeling I had while making independent films in the past, and I learn a lot from it. When it’s over, there’s a great sense of fulfillment, and I feel like I’ve spent a happy time.”
 KBS Drama Special 2026 ‘Sound:Track’ will premiere on Wednesday the 18th at 9:50 p.m. A total of eight episodes will air through December 16, at 9:50 p.m. on Wednesdays and 10 p.m. on Thursdays.
 [Shin Young-eun, Star Today reporter]
